name: PiktoMir (ПиктоМир)
reason: The 2019 institute issue and the candidate label identify PiktoMir as the educational programming environment. The technical paper separately names Pikto as the pictographic programming language and the course paper describes the PiktoMir system running on several host platforms. The lead’s referent is the environment under the index scope, and no canonical language or uniquely identified compiler is assigned.
